tasks.title: Common multiple of a list
tasks.statement: Write a function lcm_all(nums): the least common multiple of all numbers in the list; for an empty list, 1. Use math.lcm.
tasks.hint: math.lcm(*nums): with no arguments lcm returns 1.

tasks.title: Nearly equal
tasks.statement: Write a function nearly_equal(a, b): True if the floats are equal within tolerance (math.isclose).

tasks.title: School rounding
tasks.statement: Write a function round_half_up(text, digits): the number is given as a STRING; return a string rounded to digits places after the decimal point by the school rules (0.5 rounds up). Use Decimal and quantize with ROUND_HALF_UP.
tasks.hint: str(Decimal(text).quantize(Decimal(1).scaleb(-digits), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)), or Decimal("0.01") for two places.

tasks.title: Receipt total
tasks.statement: Write a function total_price(prices): prices is a list of prices as STRINGS («19.99»). Return the sum as a string with two digits after the decimal point. Use Decimal (no floats).
tasks.hint: total = sum((Decimal(p) for p in prices), Decimal("0")); str(total.quantize(Decimal("0.01"))).

tasks.title: Sum of fractions
tasks.statement: Write a function fraction_sum(pairs): pairs is a list of [numerator, denominator] pairs. Return the sum of the fractions as a string in lowest terms («1/2» or «3» for a whole number). Use Fraction.
tasks.hint: str(sum((Fraction(a, b) for a, b in pairs), Fraction(0))): Fraction reduces itself and prints a whole number without a denominator.

tasks.title: Repeatable dice
tasks.statement: Write a function roll_dice(n, seed): a list of n die rolls (numbers 1-6). The same seed must give the same result: set the seed with random.seed.

tasks.title: Data summary
tasks.statement: Write a function stats_summary(data): a tuple (mean, median, mode) of a list of numbers. Use the statistics module.

tasks.title: A secure password
tasks.statement: Write a function make_password(length): a string of length random characters, Latin letters and digits. For security use the secrets module, not random.
tasks.hint: "".join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(length)), where alphabet = string.ascii_letters + string.digits.

tasks.title: Binary notation
tasks.statement: Write a function binary_info(n): a tuple (the binary notation of n WITHOUT the 0b prefix, the number of ones in it) for non-negative n.
